links.outcome: Hindsight-bias metrics and accuracy with future data truncated versus full timeline exposure
links.effect: Full timeline exposure produced consistent hindsight-sensitive shifts across four LLMs; temporal masking reduced bias without lowering accuracy. Numeric results not reported in the abstract.
links.quote: Across GPT 5.6 Sol, Gemma 4, GLM 5.2, and Opus 5, full timeline exposure produces consistent hindsight-sensitive shifts, while temporal masking reduces bias without lowering accuracy.

unlisted_practices: Temporal masking of retrospective clinical records at the decision cutoff to prevent outcome leakage when evaluating LLMs
Paired benchmark with prospective reference answers and hindsight-trap distractors to measure hindsight bias

screen.reason: Empirically tests whether temporal masking/truncation of clinical records up to the decision point reduces hindsight bias in LLMs compared to full timeline exposure.
